detail.longDescription: I'm building a simple static HTML/CSS website, no CMS. But I do need to include a contact form. So I am looking for a simple script that can take a collection of form fields and send those to a pre-configured e-mail address. And of course there should be some kind of rudimentary anti-spam measures in there as well. Anybody have any suggestions for a script I could use? I could make my own, but I'd rather use something standard and maintained. # webdev
